tools.name: define
tools.description: Define an agentic-web glossary term or standard (id, name or alias). Returns definition, related protocols and standard summary.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Get one standard's full record by id, acronym, RFC or well-known path: status, governance, version, spec URL, probe rule, evidence and freshness.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search 133 standards and 49 terms by name, acronym, alias or use case (q or query). Returns top 10 matches plus near-miss hints.

tools.name: has
tools.description: Check one public origin live for one standard (e.g. llms-txt, ard, mcp-server-cards). Returns found/absent, URL, HTTP status and reason.

tools.name: probe
tools.description: Scan a public origin live across ~30 agent-facing standards. Pass brief: true for found_ids + extracted resources only, or compact: true to omit full absent/skipped maps.

tools.name: changes
tools.description: List machine-verified changes to standards since YYYY-MM-DD (optional step, record_id, limit) with old/new values and evidence URLs.

tools.name: stale
tools.description: List standards whose last verification is older than N days (default 30), optionally filtered by lifecycle step.

tools.name: validate_manifest
tools.description: Validate an origin's 12 agent manifests against specs, grade readiness (A+ to F) and return agent routing. Pass id for one file, brief: true (~4 KB), or compact: true (~11 KB).

tools.name: template
tools.description: Generate spec-compliant boilerplate for ard, llms-txt, agents-md, mcp-server-cards, a2a, api-catalog-rfc9727, ai-crawler-tokens-robots, security-txt, auth-md or okf.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Recommend and rank standards to implement for a goal (question or q, optional use_case and audience), or compare named protocols head-to-head.

tools.name: digest
tools.description: Get the daily agentic-web news and adoption digest for a YYYY-MM-DD date (default latest), list: true for date index, or compact: true to omit stats.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
